column13:
I am not big on AI. If I have a problem, I talk it over with a person who knows me. If I don't have a person to do that with, my life is pretty sad and this app wouldn't help. 

I also am someone who feels like he has worked on these aspects for a while. I would be concerned that blanket level findings would be things I heard about already 10 years ago and that wouldn't really be worth my time.

Perhaps some customization could be done with AI to get to know me but then I could also use any other chatbot (if I'd be so inclined) or as I mentioned above, seek out humans to talk about these things. 

In general I have never found habit tracking useful as when you are struggling with keeping habits, keeping the habit of habit tracking is frequently short-lived and adds just another habit you can fail at.
